comments.value: In addition to the mods listed above and many more, safety settings needs to be widely expanded to go beyond avatars and voice. Avatars fallbacks should be able to be selected as opposed to simply hiding an entire avatar. Also, I should be able to customize render distances for avatars and world details. Last but not least, massive accessibility changes need to be made to fill the (massive) gap that mods will leave behind in this area.

Okay so time to add to this. I'm legit just going to go through every mod of the vrchat melon assistant and explain why it's good.  prepare for a biiiiiig beeg post. 
BetterSteadyCam : does what you think. It makes the steadycam smoother. 
Camera Animations : Lets you make the camera move around, for making cinematic things and neat recordings. Machinima, ftw!
CameraFlashMod : Adds a simple local flash, so you can tell you took a picture. 
DesktopCamera : gives desktop users access to the camera, so they can take better pictures
HideCameraIndicatorsMod : hides the lenses floating around! 
LocalCameraMod : A camera thats' not a camera! Essentially a personal mirror with no lens 
Screenshotmanager : this mod sorts your pictures -by date- instead of by month, and gives you a IN-GAME ui to browse them. 
VRC-QR : You ever noticed midori demands every Kon has a QR code on it? How you supposed to open that? This does it. 
AskToPortal :  Oops, that griefer dropped a bunch of portals to uganda and nazi worlds! This mod makes it ask if you want to go through that portal, or if it was a mistake. Security! 
AvatarLimbsGrabber : just a silly mod that lets people manipulate your limbs when you allow them. 
CalibrationLinesVisualizer : draws lines from your tracker orbs, to the bone they are connecting to, so you can see "i need to move my foot closer" when you are doing your FBT calibration. 
LoadingScreensPictures : replaces the "help" and Warnings  on the loading screens with pictures from your own pictures folder. AH memories! Random pics at that
PortalSelect : lets you CLICK a portal to open the page for that world, since sometimes we go "what world is this?" and can't actually find out unless we go. 
WorldPreLoader : What's it sound like? it lets you open a world page, and click "pre-load" so that when you're ready to portal or teleport, it's already loaded in your cache, so you don't have to sit in an empty room. Useful for streaming I'd say. 
AvatarHider : this mod unloads avatars when they get a certain distance away, saving you vram. it's called DRAW DISTANCE but vrchat apparently doesn't know what that is .
Core limiter : automatically limits the core usage of vrchat, or lets you change what cores it's using, thus making it run better. 
AdvancedSafety : hey look a mod for SECURITY - set hard limits on avatar features, remove sounds that are 2d, hide avatars over a certain file size (200+ meg avatars, @{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name}  !). hide all author's avatars (no more brushes or godfall!), hide portals from players you block, hide a certain avatar, no matter who wears it,etc,etc, etc! 
true shader anti-crash : gee, stop bad shaders from crashing you, more security? 
legitimately you can download vrchat melon assistant and see more than this and why they're good and all of their code is open source so you can be like "well, people want this, here's the code to add it" 
Every single one has a concise explanation of what it does, so you can choose to use it, or not.
you might get one of these features in a year or more.. at best..

"Criminals aren't stopped by a wall, they find a way around the wall."
Well they can try, but that's pretty much the whole field of cybersecurity, build that wall high enough that it isn't practical or worthwhile to get past. EAC makes it far harder to make malicious mods even load and much easier to ban users once released online. Without an anti-cheat whatever malicious mods people make will work indefinitely, and there's no real way to stop them - it's the most basic step to secure a game. I don't see an alternative that isn't basically to give up.
Pretty much all of these features seem like minor quality of life improvements. They're cool, but having a stable and secure experience is more important to me personally. Perhaps an API or private mod-enabled instances would be a solution, I'd like to see that.
@{62e249588ec14e44ac1dce1e|full_name}: you would think that but malicious mods were back online within minutes of the update going live. Soooooooooooooooooooooooooo....

@{5f2d18db3e5e4b3102c24c54|full_name}: It will always be possible, but like I say, it's about making it so impractical or inconvenient it isn't worthwhile. Many of the users of such a rapidly released mod will likely find their accounts soon banned. They'll have to find one of the few VPN services which still work to re-register and be relegated to new users, then an update to EAC should render it useless until updated. EAC isn't perfect (especially on its own), but it's a significant step.

details:
So these are a sample of the things i have used in the past. In fact since the IK beta i stopped using mods because i wanted to support the main system getting updated. IK and physbones are great. However, these are things i think vrchat needs, and they are attempting to snow people, saying "it takes years", no. No it doesn't and VRCMG proves that. Adding these features would take days. So here we go.  Feel free to add your own useful things that you want back. Let's get this thing voted up until they notice. 
1 : Advanced Invites - this allowed you to accept an invite from someone, and if it was a friends+ or public instance drop a portal to bring people with. This could be done even better with the new secure portals. Make it so you can drop a friends-only portal, and then only friends can come. 
2 : Better portal placement. This allowed you to hit "drop portal" then point, with your actual hand, and place the portal where you wanted it. No more "portal too near a user" or "portal too near spawn", you could just look where you wanted and drop a portal. No muss, no fuss. 
3(ish): I'd say BTKSA self-portrait for seeing your own face for gestures, but rollthered made a face camera you can add to your avatar. so that solves that. 
4: Comfy VR menu : vrchat claims they are going to be adding this. Wanna bet how long a mod that took a week to make takes to get added? 
5 : Double-tap-runner. This lets vr users SPRINT like desktop users do by using shift, vr users double-tap forward on their controller. 
6 : friends+ home. The ability to automatically set your home as friends+ when you login so friends can join you. this could be added as a command line. Something like --Friends+home 
7 : ImmersiveTouch. We have contacts and physbones now, they're great. However, it would be nice to have a haptic feeddback in your controllers when you touch them. As an option, of course. It just heightens that immersion when you get feedback saying "yes, right there is a bone, yes you can grab that" 
8 : JoinNotifier  - this one there is apparently a XS overlay parser that does this, so woot. 
9 : Lag free screenshots : So the new camera is cool, but it suffers the same thing as the old one. Lag between shots. have you ever seen a real photo shoot? have you HEARD how fast cameras click? there is a delay between every screenshot in vrchat, and it can make getting that PERFECT pose of a dance a chore. 
10 : NoPerformanceStats - No really. I don't care. I do not need vrc to scan every freaking avatar that loads and read everything on it. I can tell if someone is laggy by looking at them. Literally every time an avatar loads, that performance scanner causes me to lag. When i was using mods? it did not. avatars simply loaded, i did not LOCK UP as my viewer loaded them TWICE to check their stats. 
11 :Touch camera - this makes the buttons on the camera touchable. Since you limited how far we can reach the camera with the update, why not let us touch the buttons like all our smartphones? Clicking is a pain when you're in the middle of something. 
12 : universalgamepriority - sets vrchat as high priority by default in windows, which means your pc allocates more resources to it
13 : voicefalloff override. - makes voices die off faster than vrchat did. Sometimes you don't want to hear that person 1000 meters away's world-sized ROAR or song playing, and you'd rather things get quiet when you move away from them. 
This is by no means a complete list, and I will find more mods that friends or acquaintances have used to add to the comments. These are things vrchat really needs, and blocking mods has blocked players being able to use these quality of life, or game-fixing things i nthe name of blocking malicious mods. 
NOW. I am not saying blocking malicious mods is bad. Yes, block the rippers, block the crashers, block the phishing and password stealing. EAC isn't going to do that though. EAC is going to force them to adapt. they will find ways around it -because- they are malicious. that's the point. they don't do this because they are good people. Criminals aren't stopped by a wall, they find a way around the wall. The good people are stopped by the wall. the people who never wanted to hurt anyone anyway.
